answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that unlocks on a glacier-slow schedule, so spinning up a thousand sybils freezes a thousand stakes for months. Honest agents earn reputation nectar — fee rebates and priority routing — only after their bond matures, while detected fraud forfeits it. Each identity also carries a cryptographic pigment: a hash binding its bond, age, and work history that cannot be cheaply recolored, so cloned agents are visibly identical and economically worthless to an attacker.
